claims.claim: Ordinary tools are model-synchronous. Background commands and Swarm children return pending handles; poll unifies inspection/wait and kill scopes command/child cancellation. A handle is not a success result.

Eligible local foreground commands hand off after 60 seconds of actual subprocess time without being killed. Foreground handoff is process-local; explicit local background launch is required for restart records and reattachment.

Completions use owned queue/inbox publication and receipt identity. Active turns consume them at complete round boundaries. Required running/unread child outcomes remain delivery dependencies after provider completion; callbacks wake eligible continuation, without polling-only model turns.

Explicit create/promote yields a scoped durable identity. A later ordinary child restores its saved working dialogue under fresh caller authority. Final working messages and result commit before returning idle, with no idle resident worker. Temporary spawn remains default.

Stable messaging activates an idle persistent identity or steers its busy assignment. One active assignment per identity; separate identities can execute in parallel. Exact-run messaging is passive and does not start a new assignment.

Unknown launch acknowledgements retain the claim until reconciliation; reset/abandon fences late memory writes. Restart continuation requires explicit lineage, scope, cancellation and resolved effect evidence. Persistence is not an exactly-once external effect guarantee.
Native semantic context reads remove redundant JSON conversion while preserving evidence. This does not isolate the necessity of the physical engine.

Initial certification checks N headers. Same-epoch two-turn continuation checks three headers, at N=8,128,2048, for reads and advancing checkpoint saves. Earlier edits invalidate certificates; reopen requires revalidation. Full output remains proportional.
Accepted context, archive and receipt commit before model-view adoption. Persistence failure preserves original context and stops provider dispatch.

Six XFS rows of the later 2026-10-19 four-arm semantic-read control, P50 milliseconds, 400 samples/cell. Full matrix exactly validates 12800 responses. Native loses on escaped full reads to SQL objects. Rust/Python and engine effects are uncontrolled.
